Ce que ça apporte : les invitations acce:
What it brings: accepted invitations and appointments detected by AI go straight into Google Calendar (no duplicates); “Calendar” in the palette shows your next 14 days and lets you create an event; when an invitation arrives, MintMail warns you if the slot is already taken.

Setup (only once):
1. First connect your Gmail account with the “OAuth” provider (Settings → Accounts).
2. Google Cloud console (the same project as for Gmail) → APIs & Services → Library → “Google Calendar API” → Enable.
3. Here: “Authorize Google Calendar” (a Google page opens; the “calendar.events” permission is ADDED to the Gmail one).
Important: while the consent screen is in “Testing” mode, Google makes the token expire after 7 days (you then have to authorize again). For lasting personal use, switch the app to “In production” (accept the “unverified app” screen once; up to 100 users).
